scene.text: Traditional Chinese ink-and-watercolour painting: confident dark ink-brush linework, loose expressive brushwork, soft bleeding colour washes, visible paper grain. Faces, hands and skin are built the same way as everything else — flat washes and visible brushstrokes, edges left unresolved where the brush lifted. Medium shot of a dark-haired man seated in the passenger or rear seat of a car, raising a small glass (appears to be a shot or whiskey glass) toward his mouth with his right hand. He wears a dark navy or black suit jacket with a white dress shirt and dark tie. The setting is the interior of a car at night, with the rear windshield visible behind him showing a dark exterior; a blurred warm orange light — possibly a street or traffic light — is visible through the side window to the left of frame.
